steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That was a real close one, kiddo. You completely forgot the way here, didn't you?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I'm not a kid!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: And I'm, uh, just not a hundred-percent certain...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Without a professional guide like me leading the way, how would a kiddo like you have made it through such a dangerous cave? Even I had to think twice before jumping in.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: In any case, why don't we take this opportunity to set up camp and get some shut-eye? If you don't know how to pitch a tent, I can help out.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You serious? Is this really the time for that?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The air flows smoothly here, the area is spacious but sheltered from wind and rain, the temperature is pretty agreeable, and it's dark enough to skip the eye mask.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um... I think Elysium raises some good points! But I'm not too familiar with these field tents...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: No problemo, I'll show you what to do. This model's very simple— just unfold it and it's pretty much good to go. Just need to secure a few locks...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Woah, you're right! Very convenient!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: When Logistics originally designed this model, they specifically consulted ME, the fieldwork specialist that I am!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I even graciously agreed to let them name the series after me, but I'm not sure why they didn't go through with it.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, maybe they felt there was still room for improvement, and that this tent model wasn't worthy of my name? What a shame. They should know I wouldn't nitpick over such minor things!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Tomimi, I've been hearing a lot about what a good time you've had at Rhodes Island, and that's all well and good, but I have to admit, I'm having second thoughts...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Do Rhodes Islanders always pitch tents inside lifts?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, I think Elysium is an exception...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I'll say it one more time— this isn't any regular old lift! This is the pride and joy of the Durin people, the Super Convenient Lift-o-Matic #1!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yes, indeedy. Makes for a great campsite.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Enough of that, you two. How long will it take to get to the underground city you're talking about?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yeah, what's up with that, kiddo? We've been sitting in this lift for almost half an hour already.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It's not like I'm... *sigh*... I can't help but wonder, were you mixed up in all those stories I heard about Gavial back at the tribe?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Of course! Too often am I on the receiving end of that woman's fists!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: ...I think it might be better if you turned back.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, it's not THAT often, but once every three weeks wouldn't be an exaggeration...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wait! Elysium might just be one of Gavial's regular coworkers, but...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I am Gavial's most cherished partner, the leader of Acahualla's mightiest tribe, 'Gavial's Will!'

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: There's almost nothing true about that second half.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Haha... I appreciate your generosity and selfless help. I'm sure the city will welcome you with open arms.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: (mutters) Hopefully your ugly-ass metal monsters-on-treads will come in handy...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Did you say something, Stitch?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Oh, not at all, I was just saying we're almost there.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Zeruertza.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It's extremely rare for any surface-dweller to get to lay eyes on a Durin city, let alone our beautiful––

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey, hey, hey! What the heck is THAT?!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: A giant waterfall?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's... a huge water slide!!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: No, that's not what's important. Can't you pay some respect to that beautiful, minimalistic place in the distance with a garden...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: So this is a Durin city? I thought it would be a bit more, uh... normal?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Mysterious underground palaces and whatnot. That's what the magazines always talk about.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Actually, Zeruertza is rather unique among Durin cities, because it was built by the legendary designer standing before you.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: My predecessors came here with the vision to create a city of beauty and harmony, and this magnificence is the product of their philosophy! And minimalism! It's...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Super Spinner Slide!!!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Dylan wouldn't stop going on about how much fun Acahualla was, and I didn't believe him at first, with that wicked grin on his face, but it turned out to be true!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ooh, ooh! I wanna see, I wanna see! We have to bring Gavial next time!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I wonder if the legendary Durins are interested in doing business.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Is there not a single shred of appreciation for minimalism in those empty heads of yours?! What is that heap of junk in front of you to the greatness of my work?!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Well, whatever... I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up for you people.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh, it should be somewhere around here.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Some elders in the tribe mentioned a giant cave beneath Acahualla, but I didn't expect it to be this complex.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Seems like what Tomimi and the others were saying turned out to be true.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If the worst case scenario comes to pass, it won't just be us Tiacauh that are affected. Everyone in this entire region's going to be at risk.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: There's no way it's that serious.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: High Priest! What are you doing here?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Naturally, I came because I sensed the two of you in need of help. I am the all-knowing High Priest after all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So, old man, how are we supposed to get inside that legendary underground city?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Don't be in such a rush, children. It's not every day you get to delve deep into an underground cave. Soak in your surroundings.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Take a look at these fluorescent plants. I'll let you in on a little secret— if you grind them into powder and sprinkle them over grilled fin, the flavor simply speaks for itself.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And look at these tiny little fruits on the vines...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Sorry, but we're a bit short on time here!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Alright, I know. Do you remember the safe route coming here? If I recall correctly, it's left, right, then another right, then another left?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And then four left turns in a row after that?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That would take us right back where we started.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Really? Strange.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Let me see if I can pull something else from memory... Ugh, these underground passages wind to and fro. It's hard to keep things straight! Was it right, and then uphill? Or was it downhill?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How about the more dangerous path?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: You're just as impetuous as when you were little.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: There does happen to be a path that is somewhat dangerous, but saves more time.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: See that river heading underground? Jump down.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: For real?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: The two of you should probably be fine, judging from your statures. But...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You heard the man, Zumama. Get ready, and take a deep breath––

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But, I would advise the two of you to just follow me slowly. The thing is... Huh? Where'd they go?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: In any case, this is the Durin city of Zeruertza.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I had no idea there was a place like this beneath Acahualla...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Zeruertza has had its roots here since antiquity, but with the exception of a few adventurous idiots, we've generally had little interest in the surface world.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Of course, I am an exception.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You don't much care for stories of adventure?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: That's right, I don't care for them at all.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Stop trying to twist my words! I'm not an idiot either!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's not how I see it!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Ahem... Let me introduce myself once more. I am Stitch Canvas, the most distinguished architectural designer in the city.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: As you can see, the buildings around the city that speak most directly to one's heart and soul were designed by none other than myself!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Like that big water slide over there? My respect for you is going through the roof, Mr. Stitch!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Uhh, no, that's not mine.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You must've designed the dome above this underground city, then! It even simulates the feeling of sunlight. Incredible! Good going, kiddo, you're more than meets the eye!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Have you no aesthetic taste? Are you unable to grasp what truly matters about this city?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Uhh... the greenery looks pretty nice?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Alright, we'll need to cultivate some appreciation in you.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Since you'll never get another opportunity like this and I happen to have some time before my next job, I wouldn't mind showing you a place in this city that stands as the quintessence of wisdom.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: It is my temporary residence, personally designed to bear the core of my profound philosophy...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Behold––

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Inam, look! What kind of store is that?!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: A swimsuit shop?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They're so cute!!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Durin clothes won't fit you. Not to mention your thick tail...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: P-P-Please don't talk about my tail!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It can't hurt to take a look, right?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Hey, you two. Hey!!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Elysium, we have to bring those two back...

steps.name: Durin Hawker
steps.text: Thanks for your patronage~

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Mmh, what an exotic flavor! These grilled mushrooms are as unique as you'd expect!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Kay's culinary tastes are top-class. If the mushrooms of Acahualla are not to be missed, the mushrooms beneath Acahualla are to die for! Care for a bite?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Don't you think you're assimilating way too easily?!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Ugh, my head hurts...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Hang in there, brother! Don't let these little setbacks get the better of you! All our suffering, all our hardship... It all meant something!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: The disease is taking me... The time we spent together was pure delight...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: There has to be some way, I'm sure of it...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: What about that mystical liquid? The miracle juice that supposedly restores anyone to health!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Yeah, that's right... There's still the good stuff. It might even bring back my love of life...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Help us out, kind-hearted passerby. Call out that magical name with us!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: You, with the thick tail over there, I'm talking to you!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh? Me?

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: C'mon, dig into your heart, and shout the name with us. Three, two, one!

steps.name: Both Durins
steps.text: Old Karl Mead!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um... Gavial's stew?

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Cut!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: You said the wrong line, Thick-Tail!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: P-Please don't call me that...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Where did Avdotya find such a strange woman...?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Avdotya?

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Hold on a sec... You aren't with Old Karl Mead's fan club!

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Avdotya's the only sober-looking person in the club!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Wow, they actually use sobriety as their identifying standard...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: What now, brother? Should we cancel our yodel-your-heart's-desires-out event?

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Not a chance!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: You're a Liberi who came here from the surface, aren't you? Fate brought us together today. Come, come. I still have another half-barrel of the good stuff.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Inam, they actually carry around barrels of alcohol with them!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Where did they even get their hands on barrels that big?

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: This mead's the best stuff in all of Zeruertza! Though, there are always a few know-nothings out there who refuse to admit it.

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Wanna give it a shot, Liberi? You won't regret it.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I have to hand it to you guys... You sure are enthusiastic.

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: All good, it's on us! One look at you, and we can tell you're...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: A gentleman of utmost distinction?

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Not quite sober. Just the right type to become one of us!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Are you saying I give off far out vibes? Hahaha, that's the first time anyone's said that about me. Never thought I'd be learning something new about myself here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You can count me in then. Bottoms up!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: How about the ladies over here? If you don't mind...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Mm, I'd like a try as well.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: J-Just a little bit then!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Wait, come back! Why are you drinking? We still have business to attend to!

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Huh? You're uh...

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Dear citizen, I know that confronting an important architectural designer such as myself might be a bit intimidating.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: But don't be fooled by the fact that these individuals appear idle. They actually have quite a bit of work to do, so if you'll please excuse us...

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: Are you sure you don't want some, brother? This mead's seriously good stuff.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Me? I'll pass, I don't drink.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: As one of the few Durins who needs his brain for problem-solving, I prefer to keep my head clear...

steps.name: Both Durins
steps.text: ...Ugh.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that? And why are you lifting those barrels up?

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: Did you hear what he just said? My ears weren't playing tricks on me, right?

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: This kid says he NEVER drinks? And supposedly to keep his head clear?

steps.name: Wobbly Durin
steps.text: We're in trouble, my friends. An alien has infiltrated our city!

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Open your eyes, you drunkards! They look more like aliens than anything else!

steps.name: Absent-Minded Durin
steps.text: It's time we let this fella know just how much nonsense he's spewing!

steps.name: Contemplative Lupo
steps.text: 'Harder than ice, longer than winter. More silent than tears, more futile than sighs.'

steps.name: Contemplative Lupo
steps.text: 'Inova still cannot forget the afternoon she departed. The town was like a coughing giant, exhaling rust and spitting blood.'

steps.name: Contemplative Lupo
steps.text: 'She trips and falls, but climbs back to her feet. Her steps know no pause. She doesn't ask for much— she only wants to find a land without dreams, and a few moments to waste.'

steps.name: Contemplative Lupo
steps.text: 'Perhaps a cup of hot tea and a few sips of light liquor. Indulgence is not a sin, at least in her case.'

steps.name: Contemplative Lupo
steps.text: 'What... is she after, and what is she running from?'

steps.name: Contemplative Lupo
steps.text: 'Even she does not know the answers to these questions.'
